protocol.slope_selection: maximize mean validation balanced accuracy at epoch 10 across 6 development seeds × 2 tasks; ties choose smaller slope
protocol.inhibitory_sources: 25% fixed Dale-style inhibitory presynaptic source neurons; same exact signed matrix across all conditions
protocol.fixed_condition: gain 1.0 for all postsynaptic cells and ticks

local_condition.rule: gain_i=clip(1+selected_slope*(EMA_rate_i-0.13),0.5,2.0); only inhibitory current into postsynaptic cell i is scaled
local_condition.initial_trace: target rate, so initial gain is exactly 1.0
